title: 条件状语从句

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

examples.en: You will be late unless you hurry up.
examples.zh: 除非你快点，否则你会迟到。

guess.question: If it ____ tomorrow, we'll stay at home. 空里该填什么？

options.text: rains——条件从句用一般现在时表将来
options.feedback: 对！跟时间从句一样，if 后面也不能用 will 表将来。
不对——if 引导的条件从句里不能用 will，要用 rains。
不对——这是真实条件句，不是虚拟语气，用现在时。

rule.rule: if 如果 / unless 除非（= if … not）/ as long as 只要；主句用将来时，条件从句用一般现在时（主将从现）
rule.formula: ① If + 一般现在时，主句 + will / can / may + 动词原形　② unless = if … not：You'll be late unless you hurry.　③ as long as 只要：You can go as long as you finish your work.

anchors.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will go for a picnic.
anchors.zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去野餐。

anchors.en: You won't pass the exam unless you study hard.
anchors.zh: 除非你努力学习，否则你通不过考试。

trap.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, I will stay at home.
trap.right: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
trap.why: 条件从句用一般现在时表示将来，不用 will。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——if / unless / as long as 都遵守“主将从现”；unless 就等于 if … not。

check.stem: If it ____ tomorrow, we ____ stay at home.

options.distractor: if 从句不能用将来时
主句要说将来的动作，用 will

check.explanation: 主将从现：If it rains, we will stay。

check.stem: You ____ pass the exam ____ you study hard.

options.distractor: “除非努力，否则会通过”逻辑矛盾
“如果努力就通不过”逻辑矛盾

check.explanation: 除非你努力学习，否则通不过 → won't … unless。

If he will come, I'll tell him the news.
